messages:
zoe: small question from oncall: when we do token exchange between projects, the trace/attribution in dashboards currently shows the caller project. Should we surface the original issuer too?
pavan: yes, add issuer_id as a dimension. dashboards can then toggle.
jin: any quota enforcement changes? prefer none at first. just telemetry.
mara: UX: show a pill "delegated from org-foo" on request details. clicking it surfaces delegation metadata + who gets billed.
tara: billing prefers opt-in billing inheritance. default keep current. include invoice preview before enabling for a customer.
ops-bot: rollout: flag=delegation_telemetry only, enabled in e2e and staging.
zoe: plan: add field issuer_id, delegation_flag, attribution_mode to telemetry proto. jin will implement ingestion; pavan will update dashboards.
pavan: note: ensure dimension cardinality is capped; map issuer to short ids. sampling if issuer churn is high.
zoe: ok, can we ship telemetry-only change next week?
jin: yes, will open PR today.
